column1: # verdict-diff registry: which changed files need a base-vs-head comparison before a PR opens.
# Read by scripts/harness/verdict-diff.sh (what to compare) and .claude/hooks/pr-preflight-guard.sh
# (whether to demand a stamp). One row: <path glob><TAB><runner><TAB><target>; target * = every
# target of that runner. A guard target <t> is .claude/hooks/<t>.sh with seeds in seeds/<t>.tsv.
# Add a row when a guard or keyword file joins; a chain on an unlisted file is a reason to add it.
